answer: Cumulative-funder registration fee: the n-th account funded from one wallet cluster burns 0.02 x n POA, and the counter never resets. An honest user pays 0.02 POA once; 1,000 fakes from one cluster burn 0.02 x 500,500 = 10,010 POA. Splitting across funders fails, because each new funder needs its own timber-sized deposit and every transfer into a fresh wallet is traced to the shared relic source. Each epoch 5% of accounts face an oasis check, a signed 2-minute live challenge; failing forfeits 50% of the stake.
